problem: A particle $P$ moves along the $x$-axis and its velocity at time $t$ is given by $v(t)=2t-\sqrt{t}.$ What is the total displacement of the particle between $t=0$ and $t=9?$
worked_solution:
We find the total displacement by calculating the definite integral of the velocity.

Let $d$ be the total displacement. Then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={\int }_{0}^{9}(2t-\sqrt{t})\text{d}t \\  & ={({t}^{2}-\frac{2}{3}{t}^{3/2})|}_{0}^{9} \\  & =[(9)^{2}-\frac{2}{3}(9)^{3/2}]-[(0)^{2}-\frac{2}{3}(0)^{3/2}] \\  & =81-18-0 \\  & =63.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the total displacement between $t=0$ and $t=9$ is $63.$
